review.verdict: Third on Shazzrah, fourth on Lucifron
review.summary: Third on Shazzrah, fourth on Lucifron, fifth on Ragnaros. Average parse 83, no deaths. Two Rain of Fire hits on Gehennas, five Lava Bursts on Ragnaros.

fix.title: Standing in things
fix.text: Two Rain of Fire hits, five Lava Bursts.

review.verdict: Most healing on Golemagg, 62 dispels
review.summary: First of the healers on Golemagg, second on Sulfuron (20%), third on Magmadar, Garr and Geddon. 62 dispels, 23 of them Withering Heat. 3.4 consumables per pull.

review.verdict: 29 dispels, parse 92 on Majordomo, last-but-one on Lucifron
review.summary: 29 dispels, 16 of them boss curses. Parse 92 on Majordomo. But 26th of 27 on Lucifron (181/s) and 26th on Magmadar.

review.verdict: Parse 96 on Ragnaros, Curse of the Elements
review.summary: 94 Curses of the Elements, parse 96 on Ragnaros, 92 on Golemagg, 90 on Geddon. Low on Magmadar (25th) and Shazzrah (22nd).

review.verdict: Main tank on four bosses, mind-controlled twice on Lucifron
review.summary: Main tank on Magmadar, Baron Geddon (parse 97), Shazzrah and Majordomo, 31 Elemental Fires on Ragnaros. Lucifron mind-controlled you twice. No deaths.

review.verdict: Most Gehennas' Curses removed, low damage
review.summary: 34 dispels: 8 Gehennas' Curses (the most), 6 Lucifron's, 5 Shazzrah's. Seventh on Majordomo (parse 95). But 25th on Gehennas and 27th on Shazzrah (78/s).

review.verdict: Second on Shazzrah, third on Majordomo
review.summary: Second of the healers on Shazzrah (21%), third on Gehennas and Majordomo (719 HPS), 21 dispels. 4.3 consumables per pull.

review.verdict: Third on Majordomo, everywhere else a mage with one elixir
review.summary: Third on Majordomo (1367/s) and ninth on Lucifron and Garr, so the gear works. The preparation doesn't: 1.2 consumables per pull, Greater Arcane Elixir plus Frost Power on two pulls, against a damage median of 2.7. 19th on Shazzrah and 17th on Sulfuron, and the parses only look good because the mage pool is generous.

good.title: Alive
good.text: No deaths. Two raids in a row.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: 1.2 per pull. Same note as Blackwing Lair, an hour earlier.

review.verdict: Most healing on Majordomo and Geddon, 8 Lucifron curses removed
review.summary: First of the healers on Majordomo (770 HPS) and Baron Geddon, third on Ragnaros. 25 dispels: 8 Lucifron's Curses (tied for the most), 5 Shazzrah's and 4 Gehennas' Curses. 3 Innervates.

review.verdict: Second on Gehennas and Garr, 4 Ignite Manas
review.summary: Second of the healers on Gehennas and Garr. 34 dispels, 4 of them Ignite Manas on Geddon, the most. One Rain of Fire hit.

review.verdict: Most damage on five bosses, almost double the next on Gehennas
review.summary: First on Lucifron, Magmadar, Gehennas (2057/s, 51k against the next best 28k), Baron Geddon and Sulfuron, second on Golemagg and Ragnaros, third on Garr. Average parse 92, no deaths, 6.2 consumables per pull.

good.title: Prepared
good.text: Flask, Rage of Ages and Juju Power on every pull.

fix.title: Majordomo
fix.text: Eighth, your lowest of the night.

review.verdict: Bottom three on most bosses, a trash death to a Firesworn
review.summary: Last on Majordomo, 27th on Geddon, 25th on Golemagg and Ragnaros, average parse 24. Died on trash to a Firesworn's Eruption. Mongoose on 4 of 10 pulls.

review.verdict: Third on four bosses; the Living Bomb once
review.summary: Third on Magmadar, Sulfuron, Golemagg and Ragnaros, fourth on Majordomo. Average parse 85, no deaths. On Geddon you were the Living Bomb and it caught you along with Norgewian, plus four Inferno hits.

fix.title: Baron Geddon
fix.text: Living Bomb caught you and Norgewian, and four Inferno hits.

review.verdict: Tanked Majordomo; low damage elsewhere
review.summary: Tanked on Majordomo, 87 Faerie Fires, mind-controlled once on Lucifron, four Inferno hits. In cat form 17th to 25th on most bosses; 25th on Sulfuron.

review.verdict: 73 dispels, the most in the raid
review.summary: 73 dispels after swapping in for Molten Core: 32 Withering Heats, 15 Magma Shackles, 10 Cauterizing Flames, 4 Impending Dooms. Healing was low on several bosses (last on Sulfuron and Golemagg), which is the trade-off.

fix.title: Healing
fix.text: Last of the healers on Sulfuron and Golemagg, 9 HPS on Garr.

review.verdict: Third on Lucifron, last on Magmadar and Ragnaros
review.summary: Third of the healers on Lucifron (451 HPS). Last on Magmadar and Ragnaros, no healing on Shazzrah.

review.verdict: Last on eight of ten bosses, and 8 Lava Bomb fires
review.summary: Last on Lucifron, Magmadar, Gehennas, Garr, Baron Geddon, Shazzrah (22/s), Golemagg and Ragnaros. Eight Lava Bomb fire hits on Magmadar. Majordomo was the exception, 15th with parse 91, and 5 Gehennas' Curses removed.

review.verdict: Most healing on Lucifron and Gehennas, nine Lava Bomb fires
review.summary: First of the healers on Lucifron and Gehennas, second on Magmadar and Ragnaros, 2 Dominate Minds dispelled. But nine Lava Bomb fire hits on Magmadar, more than anyone, and two Rain of Fire hits.

fix.title: Magmadar
fix.text: Nine Lava Bomb fire hits, the most.

review.verdict: Main tank on six bosses, 43 Elemental Fires on Ragnaros
review.summary: Main tank on Lucifron, Gehennas, Garr, Sulfuron, Golemagg and Ragnaros, where you took 43 Elemental Fires. Average parse 83 and no deaths.

review.verdict: Curse of Recklessness up, almost no consumables
review.summary: 106 Curses of Recklessness. Damage 17th to 27th, 0.2 consumables per pull (Mageblood on 2 of 10).

fix.title: Damage
fix.text: 27th on Magmadar, 26th on Geddon, 25th on Shazzrah and Garr.

review.verdict: Second on Garr, top seven on five bosses
review.summary: Second on Garr (1338/s), fifth on Magmadar and Majordomo, sixth on Geddon, seventh on Lucifron and Golemagg. Five Inferno hits on Geddon, the most in the raid.

review.verdict: Top five on six bosses
review.summary: Third on Gehennas and Baron Geddon, fourth on Golemagg, fifth on Garr, Shazzrah and Sulfuron. Lucifron was the outlier at 19th (439/s).

review.verdict: 69 dispels, little healing
review.summary: 69 dispels, 35 of them Cauterizing Flames, 3 Impending Dooms. But no healing at all on Lucifron, Garr, Geddon and Shazzrah, the Living Bomb caught you, and no consumables.

review.verdict: 8 Lucifron curses, parse 93 on Magmadar
review.summary: 8 Lucifron's Curses removed (tied for the most), 5 Shazzrah's. Parse 93 on Magmadar and 92 on Majordomo. 25th on Lucifron and 26th on Shazzrah.

review.verdict: Most damage on Majordomo, then died there
review.summary: First on Majordomo (1459/s), parse 99 on Lucifron, 95 to 96 on Gehennas, Shazzrah and Sulfuron. A Flamewaker killed you at 0:30 on Majordomo, the night's only boss death. 1.8 consumables per pull.

fix.title: Majordomo
fix.text: Died at 0:30 to a Flamewaker's melee, 87% to 0 over seven seconds.

review.verdict: Most healing on Garr, last on Majordomo
review.summary: First of the healers on Garr (20%). Last on Majordomo, 10th on Geddon, 88% overheal on Sulfuron. One consumable per pull.

review.verdict: Parse 96 on Garr, low on Ragnaros
review.summary: Parse 96 on Garr, 94 on Sulfuron, 93 on Majordomo. 24th on Ragnaros, two Rain of Fire hits, 1.6 consumables per pull.

review.verdict: Parse 99 on Garr, 21st on the meter on two bosses, and exactly one consumable
review.summary: Elixir of the Mongoose. That's the list. Ten bosses, one consumable per pull, against a damage median of 2.7. The parses carry it again (99 on Garr, 98 on Sulfuron), because the only people a cat is compared to are other cats; on the actual meter you were 21st on Gehennas, behind three of the four rogues, and 21st on Majordomo. You stood in three Infernos and five Lava Bursts. Shazzrah went fine, though: 10th, your best placing of the night, which in a raid of warriors is roughly where a cat lives.

fix.title: Consumables
fix.text: One. Mongoose. On a night the rest of the raid was flasked and Juju'd.

fix.title: Standing in things
fix.text: Three Inferno hits, five Lava Bursts.

review.verdict: Sixth on Sulfuron, parses in the 90s
review.summary: Sixth on Sulfuron, eighth on Garr and Golemagg, parse 95 on Majordomo and 93 on Garr and Golemagg. No deaths. Four Inferno hits.

review.verdict: Most healing on four bosses, second on three more
review.summary: First of the healers on Magmadar, Shazzrah (748 HPS, 24% of the raid's healing), Sulfuron and Ragnaros, second on Lucifron, Baron Geddon and Majordomo (748 HPS). 4 consumables per pull against a healer median of 1.3.

good.title: Prepared
good.text: Zanza, Mageblood and Distilled Wisdom every pull.

fix.title: Gehennas
fix.text: Sixth of the healers, your only quiet boss.

review.verdict: Fifth on Gehennas, a Dark Mending kicked
review.summary: Fifth on Gehennas, seventh on Magmadar and Shazzrah, kicked a Dark Mending on Sulfuron. Average parse 87, no deaths.

review.verdict: 71 dispels, 5 Impending Dooms
review.summary: 71 dispels: 20 Immolates, 12 Soul Burns, 11 Withering Heats, 5 Impending Dooms on Lucifron (the most) and 3 Ignite Manas on Geddon. Second of the healers on Golemagg, third on Shazzrah and Sulfuron.

fix.title: Garr
fix.text: No healing at all on Garr.

review.verdict: Most damage on Garr and Ragnaros, second on four
review.summary: First on Garr and Ragnaros (1482/s), second on Baron Geddon, Shazzrah, Sulfuron (1638/s) and Majordomo, third on Lucifron. Kicked a Dark Mending on Sulfuron. No deaths.

good.title: Sulfuron
good.text: Second, parse 98, and a Dark Mending kicked.

review.verdict: Fourth on Gehennas, Garr and Shazzrah
review.summary: Fourth on Gehennas, Garr and Shazzrah, sixth on Lucifron and Majordomo. Dispelled an Impending Doom and a curse on Lucifron. 5.5 consumables per pull.

review.verdict: Off-tank on seven bosses, the best-prepared raider again
review.summary: Tanked on Lucifron, Gehennas, Garr, Sulfuron, Golemagg, Majordomo and Ragnaros. 7.2 consumables per pull, 153 Sunders. No deaths.

review.verdict: Most damage on Shazzrah and Golemagg
review.summary: First on Shazzrah (1537/s) and Golemagg (1329/s), second on Lucifron and Gehennas, fourth on Magmadar and Baron Geddon. Average parse 88, no deaths.

review.verdict: Bottom half on most bosses
review.summary: 13th on Gehennas was the best. 22nd or 23rd on Magmadar, Shazzrah, Golemagg, Majordomo and Ragnaros, 147 DPS on Shazzrah. Mongoose only.

review.verdict: Second on Magmadar, a Dark Mending kicked
review.summary: Second on Magmadar (1115/s), fourth on Sulfuron and Ragnaros. Kicked a Dark Mending on Sulfuron, 26 Demoralizing Shouts. Lucifron (14th) was low.

review.verdict: Parse 98 on Gehennas, 97 on Garr and Ragnaros
review.summary: Sixth on Gehennas with parse 98, 97 on Garr and Ragnaros, a Tranquilizing Shot on Magmadar. Shazzrah was low (18th). One Rain of Fire hit. Consumables: Mongoose and Greater Agility.

review.verdict: Last on Sulfuron, bottom ten on most
review.summary: Last on Sulfuron (107/s), 21st on Shazzrah and Ragnaros, 22nd on Lucifron. Three Inferno hits and three Arcane Explosions.
